purpose: Freeze human project-level remediation decisions for the 24-work Open Library R2+A1 target-identity queue before any identity-registry mutation.
semantics: These are operational human remediation decisions, not a blinded validation sample.
RETAIN, REMAP, SPLIT, and HOLD apply to project/source identity handling only.
The decisions do not encode temporal, language, or fiction-scope eligibility.
Pair counts are preserved as impact metadata and were visible during review; they are not identity evidence.
No identity registry is modified by this artifact.
REMAP and SPLIT require an explicit resolution plan before this release can pass QC.
